annotation.title_clean: 国家税务总局关于优化离境退税服务推动政策规范落实的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the State Taxation Administration on Optimizing Departure Tax Refund Services and Promoting Standardized Policy Implementation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家税务总局 (State Taxation Administration)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Taxation Administration notice on improving departure tax refunds for foreign travelers: paperless processing, cross-regional instant refunds from September 2026, online-store pilots, a national service QR code, and risk controls against fraudulent proxy purchasing and smuggling. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Full paperless departure tax refund processing with electronic applications and invoices
From 1 Sept 2026 instant-refund applications can be reviewed online across regions
Pilot online-store departure tax refunds via Leqi platform
National departure tax refund service QR code
Stores involved in proxy purchasing or smuggling lose refund-store registration
